title: Perfect kitchen cabinet addition!
text: Perfect kitchen cabinet addition!. Great lazy susan for the inside of my pantry. I neatly can place spices on it and can clearly rotate and see everything I need at a glance. This is a great gadget for folks, like me, who have basic cabinet structures and need more organization in their lives. I now have two of these and I use them all the time. Great for the apartment owner to customize and optimize closet space.

product_metadata.title: Copco Non-Skid 2 Tier Turntable, 12 inch, Coral
features: Organize everything-perfect for organizing your kitchen, your refrigerator, your craft or hobby room or even your bathroom cabinets
Never worry about your items falling off; the non-skid surface on the turntables is molded into the platforms for durability and is easy to clean

description: The Copco turntable is great for countertops, under the sink, laundry rooms, pantries, garages and more! This handy non-slip turntable keeps everything you need within easy reach. Never worry about your items falling off; the non-skid surface on turntables is molded into the platforms for durability-easy to clean. Constructed of durable plastic. Measures 12. 2x12. 2x2 inches. Wipe clean with a damp cloth when needed.
